    SET InputsJson TO $''''''
    SET First TO True
    LOOP FOREACH It IN P.items
        SET Frag TO $'''{"type":"Container","separator":true,"items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"%It.item% (期限 %It.due%)","weight":"bolder","wrap":true},{"type":"Input.Text","id":"row%It.row%","label":"遅延理由","placeholder":"例: 仕様確認待ち"}]}'''
        IF First = True THEN
            SET InputsJson TO Frag
            SET First TO False
        ELSE
            SET InputsJson TO $'''%InputsJson%,%Frag%'''
        END
    END
    SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"[遅延理由の入力依頼] %P.person% さん","weight":"bolder","size":"medium"},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"未提出 %P.pending% 件。各案件の遅延理由を入力して「提出」を押してください（途中なら「一時保存」）。","isSubtle":true,"wrap":true},%InputsJson%],"actions":[{"type":"Action.Submit","title":"提出","data":{"act":"submit","person":"%P.person%"}},{"type":"Action.Submit","title":"一時保存","data":{"act":"draft","person":"%P.person%"}}]}}]}'''
